title: A role resolves a base merge whose conflicts touch both test and product files
why: No role may resolve a base merge whose conflicts touch both test and product files, so the orchestrator resolved one by hand on PR #1619 (coordinator, 17:05 CST Nov 7). That breaks roles-orchestrator-never-builds.
note: Done check: a mixed-conflict merge goes to a named role, with no orchestrator edit. Built as #1683, with runner 8: round 3 PASS, net value positive (coordinator 18:44 CST). Done when #1683 merges. Follow-up: merge-commit-role-scope. 18:54 CST: the Fix-line commits pushed onto #1683's reviewed head are reverted; the lines move to the stacked PR (merge-commit-role-scope). Guard: step reviewed-head-push-ask. Incident (20:05 CST, lane notes-fix-large-3, proposed step test-conflict-merge-route): merging stacked #1687 into #1722 left a conflict in hooks/test_guard.py. The builder was refused, no other role could finish the merge on main's rules, and the orchestrator removed the three marker lines itself. #1683's test-author carve-out (decision builders-cannot-edit-tests: mid-merge, a test-author writes a still-unmerged file in its own worktree) is that route, so no new step was filed. Follow-up (coordinator 21:10 CST): once #1675 lands, #1683's branch drops debt builder-edits-mutation-config, which #1675 retires. Added 21:11 CST. New sighting (lane lint-uses-pinned-tools, coordinator 01:03 CST Nov 8): a main merge that conflicted in a test file only had no role to resolve it, so the lane resolved it by hand (#1461 or #1481). Folded here as suggested slug merge-conflict-in-test-file: check that this step's route also covers a conflict in test files only (a test-author resolves it); if it does not, widen it in a follow-up, not mid-review. The folded test-file-only case is covered (coordinator, 01:06 CST Nov 8): on main a test-author may write any test path mid-merge (test_guard.py case "builder-refuse: a test-author's conflicted merge of a test file is never refused"), and the missing role text lands with #1683, with runner 8. No widening needed. Lane lint-uses-pinned-tools (02:49 CST Nov 8) asked for a step "no role may resolve a merge conflict inside a test file". Not filed: it is this step's question. On main a test-author may resolve a conflicted test file (decision builders-cannot-edit-tests via done step test-merge-conflict-role, #908; test_guard.py case "a test-author's conflicted merge of a test file is never refused"), and #1683 adds the mixed-merge role text. If that lane met a real refusal, its exact text and role reopen this here; #1521 and #1806 (merge pins hand-resolved conflicts) are the open PRs to check it against. PR #1683 is closed, replaced by #1521 (mixed-merge conflict route); this step is set done when #1521 merges. Runner 8 closes nothing for it (lane mixed-merge-resolver, relaying the coordinator's ruling of 04:08 CST Nov 8). #1871 sighting (lane process-held-end-to-end, 06:51 CST Nov 8; filed as merge-conflict-roles, folded here): a merge conflicting in test and product files was refused for both roles (builders-cannot-edit-tests on the builder's merge commit, even a side pick of the test file; test-author-scope on the product file). Workaround took two commits, fca319107 (test-author merge, #1871's side of product files) and f4cf442d9 (builder resolution), which tripped the silent-undo check. The lane asks to judge: allow a merge commit whose test-file change is only a conflict resolution, or name the route in one record. Still open on main until #1521 merges. Owner question, page item 420 (mixed-merge-test-author-scope, 07:04 CST Nov 8): #1521's round 3 notes its test-author loosening rests on a coordinator ruling (2026-11-07 13:53 CST), not the owner's word. Option a (keep #1521) widens a shared role guard, so it is marked widens and triage's pick is b (split mixed merges; #1521 comes out of its batch); the coordinator leans a. Five PRs wait on #1521 for their mixed-conflict merges: #1793, #1658, #1684, #1724, #1490 (coordinator, 07:39 CST Nov 8); added to item 420. Owner item 420 a (10:05 CST Nov 8), the widening option over the recommended b: #1521 stands; during a merge only, a test-author may write the product files git left conflicted.
